title: Smarties
body: Smarties are a colour-varied sugar-coated chocolateconfectionery. Smarties are one of Britain’s best-loved brands. There are eight colours to choose from; red, orange, blue, green, yellow, pink, violet and brown. The orange Smartie is flavoured with natural orange oil. They have been manufactured since 1937, originally by H.I. Rowntree & Company. They are currently produced by Nestlé.
